card.name: Salt endings inside drug names
card.fires_on: Pieces of the salt part of a drug name, such as ate, ionate, succ, bit or chlor, right after the base drug name. It fires where the name is still unfinished, e.g. acetate, propionate, succinate, bitartrate, hydrochloride, besylate.
